worked_examples.title: Minimum commission applies
worked_examples.inputs: BUY 100 at USD 10.00; 5 bps; minimum USD 25
worked_examples.working: Gross 1,000.00. 5 bps = 0.50, below the USD 25 minimum, so commission = 25.00. Net = 1,000.00 + 25.00 = 1,025.00

worked_examples.title: UK purchase with stamp duty, fee and minimum commission
worked_examples.inputs: BUY 2,000 at GBP 4.25; 10 bps commission; minimum USD 25 at 1.25 USD/GBP; exchange fee 1 bp; stamp 50 bps

worked_examples.title: UK sale: no stamp duty, charges reduce proceeds
worked_examples.working: Net 8,500.00 - 20.00 - 0.85 = 8,479.15 (stamp duty applies to purchases only)

worked_examples.title: JPY has no minor unit
worked_examples.inputs: BUY 300 at JPY 1,234.5; 8 bps; minimum USD 25 at 0.00625 USD/JPY

worked_examples.title: Allocation residual goes to the largest allocation
worked_examples.working: 1,000 / 3 = 333.33 each, total 999.99. Residual 0.01 goes to the first of the tied largest: 333.34, 333.33, 333.33

worked_examples.title: US corporate bond accrued interest, 30/360
worked_examples.inputs: 6% semi-annual, coupons 15 Mar/15 Sep, settle 20 May 2026, nominal 1,000,000

worked_examples.title: US Treasury accrued interest, ACT/ACT (ICMA)
worked_examples.inputs: 4% semi-annual, coupons 15 Feb/15 Aug, settle 1 May 2026, nominal 100,000
worked_examples.working: Actual days 15 Feb -> 1 May = 75; period 15 Feb -> 15 Aug = 181. Accrued per 100 = 4/2 x 75/181 = 0.828729. Amount = 828.73

worked_examples.title: Gilt in the ex-dividend period: negative accrued
worked_examples.inputs: 4% gilt, coupons 7 Jun/7 Dec, 7 business-day ex period, settle Mon 30 Nov 2026, nominal 100,000
worked_examples.working: Ex-date = 7 London business days before 7 Dec = 26 Nov. Settlement is after it, so accrued = -(4/2) x 7/183 = -0.076503 per 100 = -76.50
